title: [Master]-Bug 648538: Add mileage setup to Expense Agent wizard
summary: The Expense Agent setup wizard now includes mileage configuration and alerts users when closing the Mileage Rate Setup page without configuring any rates.
key_points: Added mileage setup link to the Expense Agent setup wizard
Users are warned if they close Mileage Rate Setup without configuring mileage rates
Changes only affect Expense Agent setup and Mileage Rate Setup pages
quote: Adds mileage configuration to the Expense Agent setup wizard and warns users when they close Mileage Rate Setup without configuring any mileage rates.
